title: 单位圆内圆的半径之和
titleEn: Sum of radii in the unit circle

knownBest.source: with one circle the container itself, r = 1
two disjoint circles: their centres are at least r₁ + r₂ apart and at most 1 − r₁ and 1 − r₂ from the container's centre, so r₁ + r₂ ≤ 1, attained by two circles of radius 1/2
